entries.basis: Reviewed independently installed declarations from frozen candidate 4af68cf00eca568596d2acc0b057b67e94700428c23be444cd6049ef2a228959. Four actual compile combinations cover React18/19 with skipLibCheck enabled/disabled using TypeScript5.9.3. Every original positive fixture compiles, all32 deliberately unmasked negative assertions produce diagnostics per run, and443 declarations per installation contain zero forbidden retired/private-upstream leaks. The checker rejects a workspace symlink before creating evidence; fixture bytes remain unchanged. Consumer documentation explicitly limits validated compiler coverage to5.9.3 rather than promising an untested range.
entries.criterion: - [ ] A-R-09 Reconcile original `R-09`: Test published type declarations with supported TypeScript versions and ensure no retired imports/augmentation or accidental private upstream types escape. Historical status: open.

limits: TypeScript5.9.3 only; this does not announce compatibility with older/newer compilers. Historical API/default comparisons, breaking-release markers and production approval remain separate. No duplicate compiler run was needed for this evidence reconciliation.
